chat.welcomeText: This platform helps you find relevant passages in the master's teachings. The AI facilitates access — it does not replace reading, reflection, or practice.
chat.philosophy: Intelligent librarian: concise answers that point to the original texts.
chat.disclaimer: Answers are based solely on the registered texts. Nothing is fetched from the internet.
